description:
Your Destiny Matrix in ChatGPT: the numerology chart of the 22 Major Arcana, calculated from a birth date.

Enter a birth date to see your matrix octagram and the arcana that lead your life right now. Add a second date to see how two matrices meet.

What you get
• A compact card in the chat: the matrix octagram, your personal qualities, comfort zone and talents, and your current life period, each linked to its arcana guide
• See your whole matrix here opens the full screen: every channel of the matrix (material karma, the karmic tail code, love, money, purpose and more), the life periods from birth to 80 with the current one highlighted, and the chakra health map
• Readings for your personal qualities and comfort zone
• Destiny Matrix compatibility for two birth dates: both people's key arcana, the pair's relationship, harmony and heart arcana as cards, and on the full screen every pair channel with both charts
• Questions in one tap: love and money, karmic tail, purpose, life periods, or the strengths and challenges of a couple
• Links to the full matrix, the compatibility page and the arcana guides on theastroscope.com
• English and Spanish

Come back for
• Compatibility with a partner, a friend or a family member: every new date is a new reading
• Your next life period, and what changes when it starts

Try asking
• "Calculate my Destiny Matrix: born June 18, 1994"
• "Destiny Matrix compatibility for June 18, 1994 and March 3, 1992"
• "What life period am I in? Born March 8, 1992"

Your data
Only birth dates, and optionally names, are used to calculate the matrix. Nothing is saved.

For entertainment and self-reflection, not medical, legal or financial advice.
